_doc: Pre-registered tests (plan docs/sofa/PLAN_2026-10-05_PRODUCTION_GRADE.md F5.1-F5.4). Human-readable copy: docs/sofa/REJESTR_TESTOW.md. A test is judged only on data strictly AFTER its registration date (data_window.from > registered_on); scripts/sofa/check_test_registry.py refuses a file that breaks this. A rule never changes after registration: a changed rule is a new test with a new id and a new date. Status PROPOSED = written, not yet approved by the operator; on approval registered_on and data_window.from move to the approval day if it is later. Status NOT_PASSED = judged at its required n and neither PASSED nor FAILED by its own stop_criterion: nothing ships. A judged test (PASSED / FAILED / NOT_PASSED / STOPPED_FUTILE) carries `result` with `decided_on`, and every scripts/sofa/*.py its `evaluation` names must exist unless it is WITHDRAWN (check_test_registry.py).

tests.hypothesis: The football model's p_central carries information on goals_total beyond Superbet's devigged price, enough that a rolling blend selects OVER legs with a positive return at the printed price.
tests.rule: For each football 05_sheet.json row with market goals_total, direction OVER, a two-sided Superbet price (market_p by power devig) and offered_odds: p_blend = sigmoid(a + b*logit(p_central) + c*logit(market_p)), a, b, c fitted by logistic regression on settled goals_total rows (both directions) of sofa_settled_row with run_date strictly before the bet day, from 2026-10-06 on only. Take the row when p_blend * offered_odds > 1.05. Graded at offered_odds from sofa_settled_row (WIN pays odds - 1, LOSS -1, PUSH / refund not counted).
tests.population: football, goals_total OVER, priced pre-start rows of SHEET in the stats-only epoch (p_central from the statistics alone); every line; one leg per (match, line).

required_n.basis: plan section 1 / F5.3: ~4,400 positions to show a 3% edge with a lower bound > 0. The 2026-10-03 night test of this rule produced 160 bets / 82 matches in 6 days (~27 / day), so ~165 days; the window end is the cap.

tests.evaluation: ROI with a 95% interval from resampling matches (as audit_ledger). CLV is not available for unprinted rows (capture_closing records printed legs only), so ROI is the criterion.
tests.stop_criterion: PASSED: at the final look (n >= 4,400 or the window end) the ROI lower 95% bound > 0. STOPPED_FUTILE: at an interim look (every 1,100 legs, only from 300 legs and 100 matches) the ROI upper 95% bound < 0. FAILED: the final look without PASSED. Interim looks never declare PASSED.

evidence.quote: tylko football goals_total (b = 0.50 [0.26; 0.75], od ratingu 09-23); najlepsza reguła +6.7% [−15.9; +29.3] na 160 zakładach — szum
football goals_total | 7 074 / 1 791 | 0,496 [0,258; 0,753]; goals_total OVER m 0,05: 160 / 82, +6,7% [−15,9; +29,3]; measure_model_information.py on the same rows b = 0,4961 [0,2699; 0,7213]

tests.caveat: b was measured on the OLD epoch's p_central (09-24..10-02), which is not the stats-only p_central; nothing of that measurement is reused - the blend is refitted on the new epoch's own rows only.

tests.hypothesis: Hockey totals legs printed on the one coupon from the score model through its price-free calibration (SPORT_CONFIDENCE) beat Superbet's closing price.
tests.rule: The hockey legs of `official` in 11_coupon.json (stats-only epoch) whose family is total or team_total, exactly as run_sport_confidence.py prints them with config/sofa_sport_confidence_calibration.json as installed on 2026-10-05 (admitted hockey keys handicap|TEAM, team_total|OVER, total|OVER; x >= 0.90, group margin <= 15%). A refit of that file is a new test.
tests.population: hockey, families total / team_total, printed official legs, both locked and fresh; graded by settle (coupon_sports.grade) at the printed price; CLV against the last pre-start snapshot (audit_clv `official:hockey`).

required_n.basis: plan F5.3 CLV criterion (>= 300 legs / >= 100 matches).

tests.evaluation: mean CLV = odds_taken x devigged close - 1, 95% interval from resampling matches (audit_clv.py); ROI beside it, never instead.
tests.stop_criterion: PASSED: at >= 300 legs and >= 100 matches the CLV lower 95% bound > 0. FAILED: at the same point the upper bound < 0, or the window end without PASSED. Looked at once, at the first day both counts are reached.

evidence.quote: hokej b = 0,98 [−0,07; 2,14] przy wadze ceny c = 0,10
totale niosą informację ponad cenę (hokej b 0,98 [−0,07; 2,14], kosz 0,70), zwycięzcy nie (b ≤ 0)

tests.caveat: b 0.98 has an interval containing 0 and came from two days (09-29, 09-30) of the price-only shadow measurement; it is a reason to test, not evidence of an edge. Which hockey families made up 'totals' in that measurement is not stated in the cited docs; this test fixes it as total + team_total.

tests.hypothesis: Superbet's single boosted prices, taken as boosted, have a positive expected value at the devigged pre-boost market.
tests.rule: Every boost in runs/sofa/<d>/10_boosts.json with combo false and fair_p set (the devigged pre-boost market; Boost.ev_at_fair = boosted_price x fair_p - 1) and a sofa fixture to settle against, taken once per odd_uuid at its first observation. A separate pool: never on the coupon, never added to it.
tests.population: single boosts only (combinations get no probability: confidence.py rule); every sport the board settles.

required_n.basis: plan F5.3 CLV / ROI arithmetic applied to the pool; no measured boost volume per day was found in docs/sofa, so the duration is unknown.

tests.evaluation: ROI at the boosted price with a 95% interval from resampling matches (audit_boosts.py / audit_settlement 7f); mean ev_at_fair beside it.
tests.stop_criterion: PASSED: at >= 300 settled boosts and >= 100 matches the ROI lower 95% bound > 0. FAILED: the upper bound < 0 at that point, or the window end without PASSED.

evidence.quote: Boosty Superbetu: 12 pojedynczych dwustronnych, średnie EV przy zdewigowanej cenie +0.1% — nie źródło zysku.
Przewaga u bukmachera „miękkiego", jeśli jest, leży w propsach, boostach i wolno poruszanych liniach — to hipoteza do pomiaru przez CLV, nie reguła.

tests.hypothesis: The official stats-only coupon (11_coupon.json -> KUPON_<d>.pdf) beats the price.
tests.rule: Every printed single of ledger variant `official` (epoch stats_only), football and tennis legs against capture_closing's close (audit_clv `official`), measured-sport legs against their graded pre-start close (`official:<sport>`); builders apart (`official:builder_leg`, never in the criterion). ROI from the ledger (record_results.py / audit_ledger.py, variant official). A rule change (refit, a new gate, a new epoch) starts a new test.
tests.population: official, stats_only epoch, from 2026-10-06 on; official:pre_stats_only and older days never counted.

required_n.basis: plan F5.3 (docs/sofa/PLAN_2026-10-05_PRODUCTION_GRADE.md line 105): ~150 positions a day, ~30 days for 4,400.

tests.evaluation: CLV: mean odds_taken x devigged close - 1, 95% interval from resampling matches (audit_clv.py). ROI: ledger units / settled, 95% interval from resampling matches (audit_ledger.py).
tests.stop_criterion: PASSED (an edge): CLV lower 95% bound > 0 on >= 300 legs and >= 100 matches, OR ROI lower 95% bound > 0 on >= 4,400 positions. Checked once per settled day; a refit / rule change ends this test (STOPPED) and registers a new one.

tests.hypothesis: Failure criterion of the coupon, written before its results (plan F5.4).
tests.rule: After F2 (calibration per curve, measure_calibration.py) and on the T-F53-coupon-edge population: if the official coupon's CLV stays < 0 with its whole 95% interval below 0 on >= 300 legs and >= 100 matches, the conclusion is 'no edge': the coupon remains an information tool, not a bet.
tests.population: as T-F53-coupon-edge.

required_n.basis: plan F5.3 / F5.4

tests.evaluation: as T-F53-coupon-edge (audit_clv.py, variant official).
tests.stop_criterion: FAILED (no edge) as soon as both counts are reached with the CLV upper 95% bound < 0 after F2 is complete; the operator approves this criterion now, before results (plan section 5, decision 5).

tests.hypothesis: Of two legs of one match on different variables priced within 0.06 of each other, the leg with the higher printed confidence wins more often than the other, when exactly one of them wins (bet.sofa.peer_choice's star).
tests.rule: Over the legs printed on the coupon (11_coupon.json singles; football / tennis pooled and each measured sport apart), form every pair of legs of one match that are different variables (leg_relations.quantity_key), |offered_odds a - offered_odds b| <= 0.06, exactly one of the two WON (graded as the ledger grades). The rule prefers the leg with the higher confidence; ties are not scored. Accuracy = share of scored pairs in which the preferred leg won.
tests.population: Legs of the official coupon (variant official, epoch stats_only) of days from 2026-10-09; pairs among locked legs included, a leg removed by a read excluded.

required_n.basis: The history measurement (docs/sofa/evidence/peer_choice_2026-10-08.md) gives 53.4% on 57,791 football / tennis pairs; a 95% half-width of 1.5 pp needs about 3,000 decided pairs in distinct matches. The measured sports have 2.9 thousand pairs in the history and no measurable edge: reported, not decided, until the same count.

tests.evaluation: Accuracy with a 95% interval from resampling matches (scripts/sofa/measure_peer_choice.py rule_accuracy on the coupon's legs).
tests.stop_criterion: CONFIRMED when the lower 95% bound is above 50% on football / tennis pooled at the required n; FAILED when the upper bound is below 52% at the required n (the star then says nothing the order of the page does not).

evidence.quote: pewniejsza noga wygrywa 53,4% [52,2; 54,7] z 57 791 rozstrzygniętych par piłka / tenis

tests.hypothesis: A printed football / tennis leg whose confidence exceeds 1/offered_odds by more than 0.03 (bet.sofa.price_gap's CONFIDENCE_ABOVE_PRICE flag) realises below its printed confidence; the other printed legs do not.
tests.rule: Over the coupon's football / tennis singles (11_coupon.json legs) graded WIN / LOSS in 07_settled.json, split by confidence - 1/offered_odds > 0.03 (the flag). Report realised minus mean confidence in each group, per sport.
tests.population: Legs of the official coupon (epoch stats_only) of days from 2026-10-13, locked legs included, a leg removed by a read excluded; each sport apart.

required_n.basis: 10-09..10-11 measured -6.8 pp [-12.0, -2.1] on 458 football legs in 269 matches; a 95% half-width of about 4.5 pp needs about 500 flagged legs in 300 matches. Tennis is reported, not decided, until the same count.

tests.evaluation: Realised minus confidence with a 95% interval from resampling matches (scripts/sofa/measure_price_gap.py section 1, --from 2026-10-13).
tests.stop_criterion: CONFIRMED (PASSED) when the flagged football group's upper 95% bound is below 0 at the required n; FAILED when its lower bound is above -2 pp at the required n (the flag then over-warns and is withdrawn by the operator).

evidence.quote: PASSED 2026-10-19 (measure_price_gap.py --from 2026-10-13 --to 2026-10-18): piłka 2 111 nóg / 932 mecze, -10,0 pp [-12,8; -7,4], ROI -5,1% wobec -5,5% reszty; tenis 68 nóg -0,8 pp [-11,7; +9,7] - za mało, raportowany

tests.hypothesis: A printed football OVER leg on a side's shots / shots on target / corners (full match or a half) whose side has an expected goal difference s >= +0.5 (SHEET's GAME_STATE / COUNT_STRETCH note) realises further below its confidence than the same markets' OVER legs with s < +0.5: the favourite that leads stops attacking.
tests.rule: scripts/sofa/measure_red_flags.py section F1 (--from 2026-10-20): flagged gap (hit - mean confidence) minus control gap, paired bootstrap over (day, match).
tests.population: Official coupon's printed legs graded WIN / LOSS in 13_results.json, days from 2026-10-20; legs without a known s excluded.

required_n.basis: 10-13..10-18: 146 flagged legs / 66 matches, flagged minus control -3.3 pp [-17.9, +10.3] (98.75%); about 500 flagged legs bring a 95% half-width near 6 pp.

tests.evaluation: Flagged minus control gap with a 95% interval (this test alone, no Bonferroni).
tests.stop_criterion: PASSED when the upper 95% bound is below 0 at the required n (then shown in the HTML as an annotation, never a gate, with the operator's go); STOPPED_FUTILE when the lower bound is above -3 pp at the required n.

evidence.quote: F1 SCENARIUSZ: -3,3 pp [-17,9; +10,3] (98,75%), 146 nóg / 66 meczów - brak

tests.hypothesis: Hockey / basketball / volleyball games the league-rate rule refuses (FRIENDLY_FIXTURE, NO_LEAGUE_RATE; epochs.LEAGUE_RATE_RULE_FROM_UTC) would have realised below their confidence had they been priced the old way (all-league rate).
tests.rule: Over Superbet's settled lines (runs/sofa/shadow/<sport>/<d>/settled.json) of the refused games, priced by the score model with the OLD rule (strict_league_rate False) as of the day, read through the installed curve and line evidence; lines with confidence >= 0.70 and confidence x odds >= 0.90. Report realised minus mean confidence and ROI at Superbet's price, per sport and pooled (scripts/sofa/measure_league_rate_rule.py --from <d>).
tests.population: Measured-sport games of days from 2026-10-14 that the rule refuses; the kept games of the same days as control.

required_n.basis: 09-29..10-12 held 17 would-print lines in 16 refused games; pre-seasons and new competitions of the winter will add games. 150 lines in 60 games give a 95% half-width of about 10 pp.

tests.evaluation: Realised minus confidence with a 95% interval from resampling games.
tests.stop_criterion: CONFIRMED (PASSED) when the upper 95% bound is below 0 at the required n; FAILED when the lower bound is above 0 (the refused games would have done at least as well as their confidence - the operator then reconsiders O1's NO_LEAGUE_RATE half; the friendly half stays a correctness rule).

tests.hypothesis: The legs the bucket design effect adds to the coupon (keys without a curve; epochs.BUCKET_DESIGN_EFFECT_FROM_UTC) realise at or above their confidence, per sport.
tests.rule: Printed legs of 11_coupon.json from 2026-10-14 whose confidence came from line evidence of a key without a curve (calibrated_on / source 'sb:'), graded WIN / LOSS; recompute each one's confidence with the sport's design effect (LineEvidence bucket_deff False on the same evidence file) and split into 'added' (would not have printed) and 'kept'. Report realised minus confidence and ROI per sport.
tests.population: Official coupon legs from 2026-10-14, a leg removed by a read excluded; each sport apart (tennis watched: the walk-forward showed its added legs at ROI -10.0% [-19.7, -0.8]).

required_n.basis: walk-forward 10-07..10-12: 477 added legs in 321 games in six days; 300 added legs give a 95% half-width of about 5 pp.

tests.evaluation: Realised minus confidence and ROI with 95% intervals from resampling matches (scripts/sofa/measure_bucket_design_effect.py logic on the printed legs).
tests.stop_criterion: PASSED when the added legs' lower 95% bound of realised minus confidence is above -2 pp at the required n; FAILED when its upper bound is below 0 (the switch is then set back to None by the operator); per sport, tennis first.

tests.hypothesis: Once the identity map's switches are on (plan docs/sofa/history/PLAN_MAPA_DRUZYN_2026-10-14.md, K1-K7), every Superbet event and player-market subject of every sport ends its kickoff day IDENTIFIED, NOT_ON_SOFASCORE (proven absence) or NEEDS_ALIAS (queued), and no identification the new rules made is contradicted later.
tests.rule: scripts/sofa/measure_team_identity.py over the kickoff days from the last identity switch: per sport and entity type (event, player) the count of UNEXPLAINED items per day; plus every identification by a new rule (source identity_anchor / DAY_ANCHOR, K3 fuzzy-within-tournament) checked against the settle: a NOT_GRADED:ID_CHANGED, an audit_settle_identity.py finding or a later manual alias pointing elsewhere is a contradiction.
tests.population: Every Superbet event on the day's board (football / tennis 01_board.json) and in sport_fixtures.json (hockey, basketball, volleyball, CS2; 1x1 loops and DUPLICATE_SUPERBET_TEAM excluded), every football player of 03_samples.json, every hockey / basketball player_model subject and every CS2 player-line nickname; each sport and entity type apart.

required_n.basis: 2026-10-05..10-14 measured (K0): unexplained per day football events 35.6, football players ~100 (comparable from 10-12), tennis 13.6, hockey 6.3, basketball 15.6, volleyball 32.6, CS2 8.0 events; 14 consecutive days after the last switch cover two weekends of football boards.

tests.evaluation: Per sport and entity: UNEXPLAINED per day over 14 consecutive kickoff days after the last identity switch; contradictions counted over every new-rule identification in the window.
tests.stop_criterion: PASSED when over 14 consecutive days every sport and entity has 0 UNEXPLAINED items other than BRIDGE_ABORTED retried under K6, and 0 contradictions; FAILED at any contradiction of a new-rule identification (the rule's switch is set back to None by the operator) or when UNEXPLAINED does not fall below 10% of the K0 baseline for a sport and entity after 30 days.

tests.hypothesis: On the lines Superbet actually posts for CS2 series rounds (rounds_total, rounds_handicap, team_rounds), the sides whose STAGED history curve (data/refit_new_markets_2026-10-15/cs2_series_rounds/curves.json, fitted on a ladder of lines) reads >= 0.70 realise more than 10 pp below that curve - the model's disagreement with Superbet's line is an anti-signal, as on 2026-09-28..10-13 (21 sides / 19 series of the passing keys realised 0.33 at 0.74).
tests.rule: Every CS2_SETTLE-graded side (WIN / LOSS) of the three families with a model_p (attached from epochs.CS2_SERIES_ROUNDS_FROM_UTC), read through the staged curve of its key: pooled realised minus curve with a 95% bootstrap interval over series, on the sides whose curve value is >= 0.70; per key apart as well.
tests.population: CS2 events of runs/sofa/cs2/<d>/settled.json from 2026-10-15, series-rounds sides graded WIN / LOSS with model_p; refunds and ungradeable sides out.

required_n.basis: 2026-09-28..10-13 gave 21 such sides in 16 days (~1.3 a day): 100 sides need ~75 days; 60 series because a series' sides are not independent.

tests.evaluation: Pooled realised - curve on the >= 0.70 sides with a bootstrap over series; the staged curves install only on the operator's go.
tests.stop_criterion: PASSED (the anti-signal confirmed: do not install the history curves as staged) when the upper 95% bound of realised - curve is below -0.10 at n >= 100; FAILED (the curve holds on Superbet's lines) when the lower bound is above -0.03 at n >= 100; STOPPED_FUTILE if n < 100 by 2027-01-14.

tests.hypothesis: The printed legs of the football score markets (result_or_over / result_or_under / btts_or_over / result_or_btts / result_or_clean_sheet / result_handicap / dc_and_over / dc_and_under, epochs.FOOTBALL_SCORE_MARKETS) and of the tennis set_score_not (epochs.TENNIS_SET_COMPLEMENTS) realise within 3 pp of their printed confidence on Superbet's own lines - the history slice curves hold where the coupon prints them. Before the switch, on 2026-10-14..15 with one pooled curve per market, the would-print legs realised -3.2 pp [-6.4, -0.2] below it (1,917 legs / 305 matches).
tests.rule: Every settled (WIN / LOSS; a refund out) printed leg of those markets from 11_coupon.json, realised minus confidence pooled and per market family, with a 95% bootstrap over matches; ROI at the printed price beside it (reported, not gated).
tests.population: Printed singles of the nine markets from 2026-10-17 (the switch), football and tennis apart, men / women / season_early classes reported apart.

required_n.basis: the 2026-10-16 offer gave ~900-1,800 would-print legs on ~140-300 matches a day; legs of one match are not independent, so the match count decides.

tests.evaluation: Pooled realised - confidence with a match bootstrap; per family where n >= 100.
tests.stop_criterion: FAILED (the curves overstate on Superbet's lines: a line-evidence / curve question) when the upper 95% bound is below -0.03 at >= 200 matches; PASSED when the interval lies within [-0.03, +0.03] at >= 200 matches; STOPPED_FUTILE if fewer than 200 matches by 2026-12-15.

tests.hypothesis: Football player legs printed only because epochs.PLAYER_SAMPLE_GATES_FROM_UTC lifted a sample-shape gate (the leg carries player_sample_rule = the first lifted gate in CONFIDENCE's order) realise no more than 3 pp below their printed confidence on Superbet's lines.
tests.rule: Over the football legs carrying player_sample_rule - the official coupon's singles (11_coupon.json legs) AND those a read removed (removed_by_reads, graded apart in 7i), so the analysts' cut cannot select the population - graded WIN / LOSS in 07_settled.json (a PLAYER_NOT_STARTED / PLAYER_DID_NOT_PLAY / PLAYER_NOT_IN_SQUAD refund not counted): realised minus mean printed confidence with a 95% bootstrap over matches, pooled and per lifted gate, and separately for the printed and the read-removed; beside it the printed player legs of the same markets WITHOUT the field (every gate passed) and ROI at the printed price (reported, not gated).
tests.population: Legs of the official coupon (epoch stats_only) of days from 2026-10-17, locked legs included, read-removed legs included (reported apart); lineup markets only (confidence.PLAYER_SHAPE_GATE_MARKETS).

required_n.basis: the walk-forward 10-12..10-15 read 55 legs / 37 matches at -5.9 pp [-15.9, +4.5] (half-width ~10 pp); a half-width of ~4.5 pp needs about five times that.

tests.evaluation: Realised minus confidence with a match bootstrap (as scripts/sofa/measure_player_line_evidence.py).
tests.stop_criterion: PASSED when the lower 95% bound is above -0.03 at the required n; FAILED (the operator switches the rule off) when the upper bound is below -0.03 at the required n; STOPPED_FUTILE if fewer than 200 matches by 2027-01-16.

tests.hypothesis: Printed tennis per-player set-games OVER legs (games_won_set1_for / games_won_set2_for, priced off the rating's neighbours since 2026-10-13 18:10Z, TENNIS_SET_RATING_PRICES) realise no more than 3 pp below their printed confidence on Superbet's lines.
tests.rule: Over the official coupon's singles (11_coupon.json) and the legs a read removed (removed_by_reads, reported apart), market games_won_set1_for or games_won_set2_for, direction OVER, graded WIN / LOSS: realised minus mean printed confidence with a 95% bootstrap over matches, per market and pooled; ROI at the printed price reported, not gated.
tests.population: Days from 2026-10-18, epoch stats_only, locked legs included.

required_n.basis: 10-09..10-16: 102 / 103 legs, 79 / 78 matches at -7.1 pp [-17.3, +2.4] / -6.6 pp [-16.8, +3.5] (half-width ~10 pp); ~4 pp needs about four times that.

tests.evaluation: Realised minus confidence with a match bootstrap (docs/sofa/evidence/tennis_aces_opponent_2026-10-17.md, the printed-legs table).
tests.stop_criterion: PASSED when the lower 95% bound is above -0.03 at the required n; FAILED (a curve refit on market-positioned lines is due, operator decides) when the upper bound is below -0.03; STOPPED_FUTILE if fewer than 250 matches by 2027-01-17.

tests.hypothesis: The tennis serve curves staged by scripts/sofa/fit_tennis_serve_curves.py (the aces family under TENNIS_ACES_OPPONENT, per-set aces / double faults, aces + double faults) read through the line evidence at Superbet's settled lines no more than 3 pp below what they would print - the condition for installing them.
tests.rule: For every settled tennis line of those markets (sofa_settled_row, run_date >= 2026-10-18), the confidence CONFIDENCE would print with the staged curves (Calibration.realised then LineEvidence.read, the day's class) - p_central re-priced under TENNIS_ACES_OPPONENT for the aces markets (process_fixture on the day's samples) - kept where >= 0.70 and x >= 0.90: realised minus confidence with a 95% bootstrap over matches; beside it the installed curves on the same lines.
tests.population: Tennis fixtures Superbet quotes serve markets on (ATP / WTA main tour, 10-30 a day), days from 2026-10-18.

required_n.basis: 10-06..10-16: 12 would-print legs / 4 matches at -20.7 pp [-50.8, +5.8] (per-set double faults / serve points) and 20 / 13 at -30.6 pp [-52.2, -4.6] (aces with the correction).

tests.evaluation: scripts/sofa/measure_tennis_serve_market_line.py --from 2026-10-18 --to <d> --staged data/refit_tennis_serve_2026-10-17 (curves re-staged on the history before the evaluation day if refitted).
tests.stop_criterion: PASSED (the curves and the switch may go in, operator's go) when the lower 95% bound is above -0.03 at the required n; FAILED when the upper bound is below -0.03 (a market-positioned refit first); STOPPED_FUTILE if fewer than 80 matches by 2027-01-17.

withdrawn.reason: The families' record (bet.sofa.family_record, family_record.json, the HTML's "rodzina na plusie" filter and the slip tiers) was removed by the operator 2026-10-31: legs stand on their own statistics and the analysts' reads. The view no longer offers the selection and measure_selection_walk_forward.py was deleted with it; the test has nothing left to judge.

tests.hypothesis: The HTML view's selection "x ≥ 1 i rodzina na plusie" (bet.sofa.family_record: a printed leg with confidence x odds >= 1 whose family - sport, market, direction - was on the plus over the days before, >= 50 legs) loses less than the whole official coupon, and may realise at or above its price.
tests.rule: For every day D: the families' record of family_record.window(D) as the view builds it, then the official coupon's printed singles of D graded WIN / LOSS at the printed price (record_results.graded_confidence). Report ROI of the selection, of the whole coupon and of the coupon minus the selection.

tests.hypothesis: A printed football leg carrying rating_market_gap (bet.sofa.rating_market_gap, RATING_BELOW_MARKET_MARGIN: a leg dependent on the favourite's strength where Superbet's expected goal margin for its favourite exceeds our pure rating's by D >= 1.0) realises below its printed confidence and about at its price, worse against its confidence than the printed dependent legs at D -0.5..0.5.
tests.rule: Over the coupon's football singles (11_coupon.json) graded WIN / LOSS in sofa_settled_row, the legs with rating_market_gap against the printed dependent legs (same group set, rating_market_gap.DEPENDENT) of matches with D in [-0.5, 0.5) recomputed by rating_market_gap.views_by_event from the day's 04_offer.json / 05_sheet.json. Report realised minus mean confidence and minus mean 1/odds per group and their difference.
tests.population: Legs of the official coupon from 2026-11-05, locked legs included, a leg removed by a read excluded; football only.

required_n.basis: printed dependent D >= 1 ran ~32 legs a day (963 legs / 360 matches 10-05..11-03); hold-out -3.4 pp [-9.3, +2.6] vs confidence on ~200 matches; ~500 flagged legs in ~200 matches to halve that width.

tests.evaluation: Difference flagged minus D -0.5..0.5 dependent legs, realised minus confidence and realised minus 1/odds, match bootstrap 1000 (independent per group).
tests.stop_criterion: Judged once at the required n: PASSED when the flagged minus band difference vs confidence has its upper 95% bound below 0 (the sentence is right); FAILED when its lower bound is above -2 pp (the annotation over-warns and is proposed for withdrawal to the operator). Either way nothing prints differently; a confidence correction would need its own measurement and go.

tests.hypothesis: Since PRICE_GAP_OFFSET (2026-10-30 08:45Z, line evidence offset by d = curve - 1/odds), printed legs at confidence >= 0.90 realise at their confidence: the -7.1 pp over-promise of the top band 10-21..11-04 (n 790; 727 legs before the switch at -7.7 pp [-11.0, -4.9], growing with d) came from the per-key offset diluting the d > 0 lines, not from the curves' top buckets (calibrated on history, n 13k-183k).
tests.rule: Printed singles of 11_coupon.json graded WIN / LOSS in 13_results.json (refund / void / unknown out), confidence >= 0.90, every sport; realised minus mean confidence, also split by d = confidence - 1/odds (< 0, 0-0.03, >= 0.03) and against mean 1/odds.
tests.population: Legs of the official coupon from 2026-11-06 (after registration; the 48 legs of 10-31..11-04 already seen are excluded), locked legs included, a leg removed by a read excluded.

required_n.basis: 1-24 such legs a day after the switch (48 legs 10-31..11-04, +2.5 pp [-4.3, +8.9]); at n 300 a match bootstrap CI half-width ~ +-4 pp, enough to separate 0 from the -7.7 pp before.

tests.evaluation: Realised minus mean confidence, match bootstrap 1000, 95% interval; the d split reported, not judged.
tests.stop_criterion: Judged once at n >= 300 legs (kickoff order): PASSED when the interval holds 0 and its lower bound is above -4 pp; FAILED when its upper bound is below 0 (the top band still over-promises: a cap or offset change for the top band needs its own measurement and the operator's go). Nothing prints differently meanwhile.

evidence.quote: 727 nóg sprzed `PRICE_GAP_OFFSET` daje −7,7 pp [−11,0, −4,9], a 48 nóg z 10-31..11-04 daje +2,5 pp [−4,3, +8,9]

tests.hypothesis: The schedule term (epochs.SCHEDULE_TERM, schedule_term_v1, frozen coefficients config/sofa_schedule_terms.json = fr_frozen of the exam, spec 87a5087f) improves the football 1X2 probabilities on new data: the pure rating goals centres x exp(t) give a lower Brier score of the 1X2 outcome than the same centres without the term.
tests.rule: Football SHEET rows of epochs.SCHEDULE_TERM_MARKETS from 2026-11-10 that carry both p_central and p_central_no_schedule_term (inverted shadow) and a settled outcome in sofa_settled_row / 07_settled.json; the metric is the exam's: per match, the 1X2 Brier of the result_1x2 rows from the corrected centres minus from the uncorrected ones (Delta < 0 = the term helps), averaged over matches; the other in-scope markets reported beside it, never pooled into Delta.
tests.population: Every settled football match with a result_1x2 row under the switch (printed or not), friendlies and awarded results excluded as SHEET excludes them; national-team and no-coverage rows (t = 0) count with Delta 0.

required_n.basis: Exam effect -0.000223 per match; validate 2026-11-09 Delta -0.000327 [-0.000513, -0.000137] on 137,984 matches gives a per-match sd of 0.0356; one-sided alpha 0.05, power 0.80 to see an effect of the exam's size: n = ((1.645 + 0.842) x 0.0356 / 0.000223)^2 ~ 158,000 matches. Live volume ~300-400 rated football matches a day: about 13-17 months. Judged at the later of 6 weeks and the required n (pre-registration section 11).

tests.evaluation: Pigeonhole bootstrap over home x away team (as the exam, scripts/sofa/measure_schedule_exam.py cluster_boot), 2000 reps, seeded; Delta and its 95% interval.
tests.stop_criterion: Withdrawal rule frozen in docs/sofa/evidence/schedule_context_prereg_2026-11-09.md section 11: at the later of 6 weeks and the required n, if the uncorrected centres are better - Delta > 0 with its lower 95% bound > 0 - the switch goes off from the next day 00:00Z (FAILED). Delta < 0 with the upper bound < 0: PASSED. Otherwise NOT_PASSED: the switch stays (the exam decided it). Nothing is judged earlier; no peeking changes the rule.

tests.hypothesis: Without the closeness term (epochs.CARDS_CLOSENESS_OFF, cards_closeness_off_v1) the football cards probabilities are better on new data: SHEET's cards_points_for / cards_points_total p at the centre without exp(g1 |s| + g2 s^2) has a lower log-loss on Superbet-settled lines than the same row's p with the term put back.
tests.rule: Every Superbet-settled cards_points_for / cards_points_total line from 2026-11-10 (07_settled.json, outcome WIN / LOSS, p_central present). Arm off = the row's p_central. Arm on = the NB at the row's own dispersion (solved from its p_central, centre and line, as docs/sofa/evidence/kartki_bez_closeness_2026-11-09.md) at centre x closeness_stretch.load_table().multiplier(market, s), s the home side's expected goal difference of the row's GAME_STATE note. Delta = mean per line of log-loss(off) - log-loss(on); < 0 = the switch helps. Printed realised - confidence of the cards legs reported beside it, never pooled into Delta.
tests.population: Football cards_points_for / cards_points_total lines Superbet offered and SETTLE graded from 2026-11-10, printed or not; rows without a GAME_STATE supremacy (t unknown) out.

required_n.basis: 10-21..11-08: Delta -36.2e-4 [-75.6, +1.4] on 18,542 lines / 1,200 matches (match bootstrap SE ~19.5e-4); one-sided alpha 0.05 at power 0.80 for that effect needs SE ~12.9e-4: 1,200 x (19.5 / 12.9)^2 ~ 2,750 matches, about 6 weeks at ~65 matches a day with cards lines.

tests.evaluation: Match bootstrap (event id), 2000 reps, seeded; Delta and its 95% interval.
tests.stop_criterion: At the later of 6 weeks and 2,750 matches: Delta > 0 with its lower 95% bound > 0 - the term back on the cards from the next day 00:00Z (FAILED); Delta < 0 with the upper bound < 0 - PASSED; otherwise NOT_PASSED and the switch stays. Nothing judged earlier.

tests.hypothesis: A printed single marked lesser_loss (bet.sofa.lesser_loss: overround < 0.086, confidence - 1/odds >= -0.047, sample_size >= 20) loses less per unit staked than an unmarked printed single; its 'pewna' tier (confidence >= 0.85) wins about 90% of the time at about its price.
tests.rule: Printed singles of 11_coupon.json graded WIN / LOSS in 13_results.json (refund / void / unknown out), every sport; the mark recomputed by lesser_loss.annotate from the leg's printed confidence / odds and its own overround / sample_size (scripts/sofa/measure_lesser_loss.py). ROI before the tax per group: marked, pewna, unmarked.
tests.population: Legs of the official coupon from 2026-11-12, locked legs included, a leg removed by a read excluded.

required_n.basis: 10-30..11-10: ~260 marked legs a day in ~100 matches, ~55 pewna legs a day; a match-bootstrap half-width ~3 pp on the marked ROI at 1,000 matches, ~3.5 pp on pewna at 300 matches.

tests.evaluation: Marked minus unmarked ROI (before the tax), match bootstrap 1000, 95% interval; pewna: realised hit, mean confidence, mean 1/odds and ROI with its interval (scripts/sofa/measure_lesser_loss.py --from 2026-11-12).
tests.stop_criterion: Judged once when both counts are reached (kickoff order). Mark PASSED when the marked minus unmarked ROI interval lies above 0; FAILED when its upper bound is below +1 pp (the mark is withdrawn, proposed to the operator). Pewna reported: PASSED when its ROI interval holds 0 or lies above it and its hit is >= 0.87; FAILED when its ROI upper bound is below 0. Nothing prints differently either way; the 12% tax is reported beside every number.
